name: Volkov-Saito Precision VS-O/U Sport 'Duelist'
description:
The Volkov-Saito VS-O/U Sport is a break-action over-under shotgun chambered in 12 gauge with 30-inch barrels, a single selective trigger, and an ejector system that throws spent shells clear of the action. The weapon is hand-engraved with a geometric pattern that is unique to each unit — no two Duelists bear the same engraving — and the stock is shaped from figured walnut selected for grain quality.

The Duelist is a premium sporting shotgun for competitive trap and skeet shooting, positioned at the top of the market alongside the finest sporting arms ever produced. The over-under barrel configuration provides two different choke settings in a single weapon — typically improved cylinder on the bottom barrel for close targets and modified on the top barrel for distance targets — selectable by trigger position.

Volkov-Saito produces the Duelist in their premium workshop, limited to two hundred units per year. The waiting list extends to four years, and secondary-market prices consistently exceed new-purchase prices. In the insular world of competitive clay shooting, the Duelist is the weapon against which all others are measured — not always fairly, but always inevitably.
specifications:
caliber: 12 gauge
effective_range: 50 meters (sporting loads)
rate_of_fire: Two shots (break-action reload)
magazine_capacity: 2 rounds
weight: 3.4 kg
tactical_use: No tactical application. This is a premium sporting shotgun for competitive clay shooting. The two-shot capacity and long barrels make it unsuitable for any defensive or offensive role. Its value is entirely in sporting and collectible contexts.
cultural_context: The Duelist is wealth, taste, and skill combined in steel and walnut. In the Mid and Spire social circles where competitive shooting serves as networking and status display, the Duelist is the membership card. Owning one places the holder in a community of two hundred per year — a manufactured exclusivity that Volkov-Saito manages with the precision they apply to their firearms.
story_hooks: A Duelist with unique engraving is found at a murder scene — a Φ40,000 sporting shotgun used to kill someone with birdshot at close range. The weapon is easily traceable, which suggests the killer either didn't care about being identified or intended the weapon to send a message.
The four-year waiting list for a Duelist is compromised, and the personal information of two hundred of GLMZ's wealthiest residents is leaked to criminal networks.
physical_description: A break-action over-under shotgun with twin 30-inch barrels and a single selective trigger, its figured walnut stock worn smooth from use. The receiver bears hand-engraved geometric patterns unique to this unit, chrome-plated and showing patina at the edges where moisture has crept in. The ejector system is tight, throwing brass clear with mechanical precision—a premium sporting arm now repurposed for something far deadlier than clay pigeons.
